description.summary: The target creature is surrounded by a fuzzy haze that affects both their body and their mind, making them slower to react to danger.
description.value: The target creature is surrounded by a fuzzy haze that affects both their body and their mind, making them slower to react to danger. If the target fails a Will save, they have any Evasion type feature or feat reduced by 1 stage (Improved evasion > evasion > nothing) for the duration of the spell. This affects any similar effect like a warrior’s mettle talent. This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for July 2021 by DeadKingKicker.
